test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following figures can be formed on folding the given sheet of paper in the question?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6eae03e49578d9ad52ec7879c6ab35109be2bf26e8e71a2836d3a5ed026ed779.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9039f631a90d0e00d8ef813d678324e89fb10b2b4703c28627230f9bdae24eec.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions becomes opposite to each other and the remaining two faces becomes opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

 
• 1 → 5
 
• 2 → 3
 
• 4 → 6

Therefore,

 
• Option(1) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5e05842bdf500909687945d6632da3388c1e8e3e20c754f6be717aa053f2a84.png] ⇒ Can be formed as a box from the given sheet (As 2, 4 and 5 are one numbers of each opposite pairs)
 
• Option(2) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75f49b1aa5c592cfb8974f5661de7fbeb4ffb13f30cac630d387745f8df13a56.png] ⇒ Cannot be formed as a box from the given sheet (As 2 and 1 are one of the opposite pairs)
 
• Option(3) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d93f4c79297c9366b44959a4311ae9f8e1dae16471a9aa6e6d58c9876e291f76.png] ⇒ Cannot be formed as a box from the given sheet (As 4 and 6 are one of the opposite pairs) 
 
• Option(4) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2785d7803ec1ef690b0823a971ada2450a773ca23082f43c23fcf7c0eaf16a5f.png] ⇒ Cannot be formed as a box from the given sheet (As 1 and 2 are one of the opposite pairs)

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.
